prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup targeted source-template layout correction. Edit this full long public magazine blog page, preserving all exact content, configured text brand 隔离示例手记 and forest-green #44684f accent, header navigation, 首页 selected, profile intro, featured content, all module titles/empty copy, source counts and footer. No content/function/state additions. Correct ONLY the source magazine grid relationships below the featured section:
1. Keep 精选文章 exactly as-is: first card spans 2 of 3 columns, second card 1 of 3, larger first featured title.
2. 最近更新 is NOT featured. It must be an equal three-column magazine grid: show the two existing latest cards in the FIRST and SECOND one-third-width columns, EQUAL card widths and EQUAL smaller title font. The THIRD one-third column stays empty because there are only two fixture posts. Do not stretch the first latest card across two columns and do not invent a third post. Keep 查看全部文章 → below this module.
3. The next row is the source two-column lower module grid. Put 专题合集 section in LEFT half with its existing one collection card “专题 · 1 篇 / 记录的方法 / 隔离盘点示例合集”. Put 我的项目 section in RIGHT half in that SAME ROW, with existing “暂无项目。”. Each section title/rule width is its half.
4. 友情链接 is the following source row in the LEFT half, with “暂无友情链接。”. Do not make any lower module falsely span all columns.
Preserve all other text/controls/body order and public-only boundaries, the magazine masthead and featured hierarchy, no owner rail/images/avatar/friends/projects invented, no new buttons or metadata. Keep a single complete long magazine page with flat surfaces, readable Chinese and natural spacing. Full canvas preserved, no crop.
